name: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
title: PAD: Policy-Aware Data Valuation for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving increasingly depends on scaling training demonstrations, yet data growth does not guarantee proportional gains. However, additional data do not guarantee better policies: a demonstration that benefits one planner may be redundant or harmful to another. Existing curation methods typically infer data value from intrinsic sample properties or training-dependent proxies t
